name: Pinpoint Spellcasting (Metamagic)
body:
You reduce the potency of a spell but increase the range.

Benefit: When casting a spell with a range of close, medium, or long, for every -1 you apply to your caster level, you increase the spell’s range according to the chart below. You cannot decrease your caster level below the minimum required to cast the spell.

Spell Range	Range Increase*
Close	+5 ft.
Medium	+10 ft.
Long	+40 ft.

* Per -1 to caster level.
